title: TGR-EvoDAG: A DAG-based Multi-Agent Code Evolution Framework for Generative Recommendation on Tencent
title_zh: TGR-EvoDAG：腾讯面向生成式推荐的基于DAG的多智能体代码进化框架

paragraphs.en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have enabled automated code evolution, offering a promising paradigm for algorithm discovery. However, current recursive self-improvement (RSI) research for sequential recommendation faces a critical dilemma: general-purpose code evolution frameworks possess flexible search mechanisms but lack domain-specific feedback, whereas recommender-specific evolution frameworks utilize rich feedback but rely on linear evolution. More critically, naively integrating them fails when applied to Generative Recommendation (GR). Unlike traditional end-to-end models, GR relies on a module-cascaded training pipeline (i.e., tokenization, pre-training, and alignment). In this paradigm, existing naive evolution methods inevitably suffer from i) cost blindness: squandering budgets by ignoring stage-asymmetric retraining overheads; and ii) short-sighted evaluation: discarding promising upstream innovations that temporarily regress metrics before downstream adaptation. To bridge these gaps, we propose TGR-EvoDAG, a multi-agent code evolution framework explicitly tailored for GR. TGR-EvoDAG organizes code evolution as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) that explicitly maintains multiple evolution branches and merges complementary innovations, and harmonizes an advanced search mechanism with rich GR-specific diagnostic feedback. We further introduce stage-aware cost planning to optimize real-world GPU-hour budgets, and active downstream co-adaptation to navigate temporary regressions and unlock deferred cross-stage gains. On public Amazon datasets, TGR-EvoDAG marks the first autonomous evolution of a complete GR pipeline, improving offline metrics by up to 37.4% and boosting Agent4Rec simulated user satisfaction by 19.7% over the strongest GR baseline. Furthermore, in industrial settings, the evolved GR achieves a 12.16% relative improvement in offline Hit@1 and, when deployed as an additional retrieval channel on Tencent’s large-scale commercial media platform, a statistically significant 0.40% increase in online click-through rate (CTR).

paragraphs.en: With the emergence of Large Language Model (LLM) agents, LLM-driven code evolution has emerged as a promising paradigm, paving the way for Recursive Self-Improvement ( Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . This approach gives agents research-like capabilities: they propose hypotheses, modify code, run experiments, and collect feedback, enabling algorithms to self-evolve continuously ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Chan et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2021 ) . To accelerate experimental iterations and reduce labor costs for recommendation engineers, an increasing number of studies have introduced this paradigm into the field of sequential recommendation ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Mu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）智能体的出现，由 LLM 驱动的代码演化已成为一种有前景的范式，为递归自我改进铺平了道路（ Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ）。 这种方法赋予智能体类似研究的能力：它们提出假设、修改代码、运行实验并收集反馈，使算法能够持续自我演化（ Lu et al., 2024 ; Chan et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2021 ）。 为了加速实验迭代并降低推荐工程师的人力成本，越来越多的研究将这一范式引入序列推荐领域（ Wang et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Mu et al., 2026 ）。

paragraphs.en: While general-purpose code evolution has achieved sophisticated search mechanisms, such as multi-branch exploration and cross-branch merging, through population-based approaches ( Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ; Lange et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) and tree/graph-based architectures ( Jin et al., 2026 ) , they generally lack the domain-specific feedback signals essential for recommender systems. Conversely, existing recommender evolution frameworks invest heavily in feedback quality by utilizing simulated users and diagnostic probes, yet they predominantly rely on primitive search mechanisms. For instance, SERS ( Wang et al., 2026 ) uses a simple fan-out/fan-in strategy without branch maintenance; EvoRec performs greedy, round-by-round linear advancement ( Mu et al., 2026 ) ; and Self-EvolveRec samples a parent node from multiple elites ( Kim et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管通用代码演化已通过基于种群的方法（Romera-Paredes 等，2024；Lange 等，2026；Jiang 等，2025）和基于树/图的架构（Jin 等，2026）实现了诸如多分支探索与跨分支合并等复杂搜索机制，但它们普遍缺乏对推荐系统至关重要的领域特定反馈信号。 相反，现有的推荐系统演化框架通过利用模拟用户和诊断探针在反馈质量上投入大量精力，但它们主要依赖原始的搜索机制。 例如，SERS（Wang 等，2026）采用简单的扇出/扇入策略而不维护分支；EvoRec 执行逐轮的贪心线性推进（Mu 等，2026）；Self-EvolveRec 则从多个精英节点中采样一个父节点（Kim 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: These simple search mechanisms restrict existing recommender evolution frameworks to traditional end-to-end models, where modifications incur a uniform full-training cost and produce immediate metric changes ( Kang and McAuley, 2018 ; Hidasi et al., 2016 ; Sun et al., 2019 ) . They fail on Generative Recommendation (GR) , an increasingly popular paradigm built on a cascaded pipeline (tokenizer, pre-training, and alignment) ( Geng et al., 2022 ; Rajput et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Deng et al., 2025 ; Pang et al., 2025 ; TGR Team et al., 2026 ) , because they cannot effectively maintain or merge cross-stage innovations. While explicitly combining advanced general-purpose search mechanisms with domain-specific feedback seems like a natural solution, this naive integration still falls short. General-purpose mechanisms fundamentally rely on two implicit assumptions that a cascaded GR pipeline structurally violates: 1) Cost Blindness vs. Stage-Dependent Costs. General-purpose search policies evaluate all candidate nodes uniformly, ignoring how much retraining an edit requires. In GR, however, retraining costs are highly asymmetric: modifying the upstream Tokenizer forces a full-pipeline retraining, whereas editing the downstream Alignment stage only re-runs the final segment. Being “cost-blind,” existing frameworks cannot triage edits based on actual overhead, systematically squandering budgets on expensive upstream explorations. 2) Short-Sighted Evaluation vs. Deferred Gains. General-purpose frameworks judge modifications by their immediate scores, pruning candidates that initially regress performance. However, because GR stages are tightly coupled, modifying an upstream stage almost always breaks compatibility with the unadapted downstream stage, causing a temporary performance drop. Lacking structural awareness, existing frameworks abandon these upstream innovations, missing the opportunity to actively schedule the necessary downstream adaptations to unlock “deferred” gains ( Liu et al., 2025a ) .

paragraphs.en: To this end, we present TGR-EvoDAG, a multi-agent code evolution framework explicitly built for cascaded GR pipelines. TGR-EvoDAG seamlessly marries advanced graph search mechanisms with rich domain-specific feedback. It represents the search space as a Code Directed Acyclic Graph (Code DAG), driven by a five-stage collaborative Agent workflow (comprising an Operator Selector, Architect-Critic, Coder-Reviewer, Distiller, and Pruner) that digests fine-grained recommendation signals, such as mathematical probes and simulated user ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) . Building upon this foundation, TGR-EvoDAG tightly integrates the multi-agent workflow with two novel mechanisms to overcome the inherent blind spots of cascaded pipelines. First, to address cost blindness, we introduce Stage-Aware Cost Planning via the Operator Selector. Each DAG node records the exact pipeline stages its edit touches and the corresponding retraining overhead. Empowered by this stage-aware schema, our Operator Selector dynamically balances the expected performance gain against the actual GPU-hour cost, preventing the framework from blindly exhausting budgets on expensive upstream explorations. Second, to overcome short-sighted evaluation, we design Active Downstream Co-Adaptation. Instead of rigidly discarding candidates that cause immediate performance drops, TGR-EvoDAG explicitly retains these seemingly “regressed” upstream branches. When the framework identifies an upstream edit (e.g., Tokenizer) lacking a corresponding downstream adaptation (e.g., Pre-training), the agents deliberately schedule a child node to adapt the downstream stage. This recovers gains from upstream edits that greedy frameworks would discard.

paragraphs.en: LLM-driven Code Evolution. General-purpose code evolution relies on three search paradigms. Linear inheritance advances a single thread (e.g., AIDE, MLE-STAR ( Nam et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2024 ) ), often stalling at local optima. Multi-elite sampling draws parents from elite archives to preserve diversity ( Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ; Novikov et al., 2025 ; Lange et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2024 ) . Explicit tree search maintains multiple branches for persistent exploration (e.g., SELA, Arbor ( Chi et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2026 ) ); notably, CORAL ( Qu et al., 2026 ) even removes fixed strategies and delegates all search routing to the agent itself. Despite their sophisticated search, these frameworks fail on Generative Recommendation (GR). First, they lack the domain-specific feedback (e.g., mathematical probes, simulated users) essential for GR. Second, facing GR’s cascaded pipeline, they lack stage-aware cost planning to handle asymmetric retraining overheads, and cross-stage mechanisms to merge and co-adapt innovations from upstream tokenization down to alignment.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 驱动的代码演化。 通用的代码演化依赖于三种搜索范式。 线性继承推进单一线程（例如 AIDE、MLE-STAR（Nam 等，2025；Yang 等，2025；Guo 等，2024）），常常停滞在局部最优。 多精英采样从精英档案中抽取父代以保持多样性（Romera-Paredes 等，2024；Novikov 等，2025；Lange 等，2026；Liu 等，2025b；Liu 等，2024；Ye 等，2024）。 显式树搜索维护多个分支以实现持续探索（例如 SELA、Arbor（Chi 等，2024；Jin 等，2026））；值得注意的是，CORAL（Qu 等，2026）甚至移除了固定策略，将所有搜索路由委托给智能体本身。 尽管这些框架拥有复杂的搜索机制，但在生成式推荐（GR）上却表现不佳。 首先，它们缺乏对 GR 至关重要的领域专用反馈（例如数学探针、模拟用户）。 其次，面对 GR 的级联式流水线，它们既缺乏阶段感知的成本规划来应对非对称的重训练开销，也缺乏跨阶段机制来合并并协同适配从上游 tokenization 到下游对齐的各类创新。

paragraphs.en: Generative Recommendation (GR). GR replaces classical ID-based models ( Hidasi et al., 2016 ; Kang and McAuley, 2018 ; Sun et al., 2019 ) with direct semantic-ID generation ( Tay et al., 2022 ; Rajput et al., 2023 ) . Training GR forms a cascaded three-stage pipeline : a Tokenizer quantizes items into hierarchical IDs ( Lee et al., 2022 ) ; Pre-training fits a sequence-to-sequence generator; and Post-training aligns it with preference signals ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Deng et al., 2025 ; OneRec Team, 2025 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) . Current manual research optimizes each stage locally, spanning better tokenizers ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Tan et al., 2024 ; Hou et al., 2025 ) , quantization ( Fifty et al., 2025 ) , and architectures ( Zhai et al., 2024 ) . Because stage-wise improvements are complementary , the global optimum hides in their combinations, a space no single-threaded search can cover. Furthermore, these stages are tightly coupled ( Liu et al., 2025a ) ; upstream innovations often trigger temporary metric drops, requiring downstream re-adaptation to unlock their delayed value. No prior work autonomously evolves this complete pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式推荐（GR）。 GR 以直接的语义 ID 生成方式（Tay 等，2022；Rajput 等，2023）取代了经典的基于 ID 的模型（Hidasi 等，2016；Kang 和 McAuley，2018；Sun 等，2019）。 GR 的训练构成一个级联的三阶段流水线：分词器（Tokenizer）将物品量化为层次化 ID（Lee 等，2022）；预训练拟合一个序列到序列的生成器；后训练则使其与偏好信号对齐（Chen 等，2024；Deng 等，2025；OneRec 团队，2025；Yu 等，2026）。 目前的人工研究只是对各个阶段进行局部优化，涵盖更好的分词器（Zheng 等，2024；Wang 等，2024；Tan 等，2024；Hou 等，2025）、量化方法（Fifty 等，2025）以及模型架构（Zhai 等，2024）。 由于各阶段的改进是互补的，全局最优解隐藏在它们的组合之中，这是一个任何单线程搜索都无法覆盖的空间。 此外，这些阶段紧密耦合（Liu 等，2025a）；上游的创新往往会引发暂时的指标下降，需要下游的重新适配才能释放其延迟的价值。 尚未有先前的工作能够自主地演化这一完整流水线。

paragraphs.en: Self-Evolving Recommender Systems. A nascent line applies code evolution to recommenders. SERS ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , deployed in YouTube’s production system, evolves delta edits against a fixed baseline via a simple fan-out/fan-in strategy. EvoRec ( Mu et al., 2026 ) advances the model architecture greedily, round by round, keeping only the single best variant at each step. Concurrently, Auto-RecSys ( Li et al., 2026 ) applies autonomous research agents to industry-scale recommender models. paragraphs.en: Let 𝒰 \mathcal{U} and ℐ \mathcal{I} denote the sets of users and items. In sequential recommendation, given a user’s chronological interaction history S u S_{u} , the objective is to predict the next item i t + 1 i_{t+1} . Generative Recommendation (GR) reformulates this as a conditional sequence generation problem. It maps items to discrete semantic identifiers (SIDs) and autoregressively generates the SID tokens of i t + 1 i_{t+1} conditioned on S u S_{u} . Training a GR model therefore involves three tightly coupled stages: (1) Stage I: Tokenization. A tokenizer (e.g., RQ-VAE) discretizes item content into hierarchical semantic IDs. (2) Stage II: Generative Pre-training. A sequence-to-sequence Transformer is trained to predict the next item’s tokens via hierarchical cross-entropy. (3) Stage III: Post-training Alignment. The model is further aligned with desired recommendation objectives (e.g., exact match or prefix similarity) using preference optimization or reinforcement learning. We detail the concrete implementation details and mathematical formulations of these three stages (e.g., RQ-Kmeans quantization, exact baseline objectives, and post-training variants) to Appendix A.3 .

paragraphs.en: Instead of simply counting search iterations, TGR-EvoDAG manages a realistic GPU-hour budget b ( t ) b^{(t)} via empirical cost profiling. Every evaluated node explicitly records the actual time spent on each pipeline stage (e.g., Tokenizer, Pre-training, Alignment). Provided with these historical records, the Operator Selector specifies the target_stage and training_scope of its intended edit using a structured JSON schema. This allows the system to estimate the expected GPU-hour cost 𝒞 c \mathcal{C}_{c} before execution. By weighing this expected cost against anticipated performance gains, the Operator Selector makes strategic budgeting decisions. For instance, it deliberately postpones expensive upstream edits (which force full-pipeline retraining) until cheaper downstream architectures fully mature, preventing premature budget exhaustion.
paragraphs.zh: 与简单地统计搜索迭代次数不同，TGR-EvoDAG 通过经验成本剖析来管理现实的 GPU 小时预算 b ( t ) b^{(t)}。 每个被评估的节点都显式记录每个流水线阶段（例如，Tokenizer、Pre-training、Alignment）实际花费的时间。 在获得这些历史记录后，Operator Selector 使用结构化的 JSON 模式指定其拟执行编辑的 target_stage 和 training_scope。 这使得系统能够在执行前估算预期的 GPU 小时成本 𝒞 c \mathcal{C}_{c}。 通过将这一预期成本与预期的性能提升进行权衡，Operator Selector 做出战略性的预算决策。 例如，它会刻意推迟昂贵的上游编辑（此类编辑会迫使整个流水线重新训练），直到更便宜的下游架构完全成熟，从而避免预算过早耗尽。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we conduct numerical experiments to answer five research questions. (RQ1) : Does code-level DAG evolution with domain-specific feedback beat both general and recommender-specific evolutionary frameworks? (RQ2) : Does stage-aware cost planning overcome cost blindness and budget for expensive upstream (Tokenizer) innovations? (RQ3) : Do active downstream co-adaptation and cross-branch merging overcome short-sighted evaluation ? (RQ4) : Can the evolved architecture transfer to real-world industrial scenarios? (RQ5) : Are user diagnosis and mathematical probes causally useful in driving mutations?

paragraphs.en: All frameworks evolve on a unified platform under a fixed budget B = 24 B=24 GPU-hours, using Claude CLI ( Liu et al., 2026 ) with all inference routed to GLM-5.2 ( GLM-5-Team et al., 2026 ) , starting from an identical TIGER seed codebase (plus post-training variants SDPO, SPRec, ReReGRPO, APAO) on the Amazon Office Products dataset. The final champion architecture evolved on this public dataset is subsequently transferred to Tencent’s large-scale industrial platform for real-world validation (Section 5 ). We compare against general frameworks (AlphaEvolve ( Novikov et al., 2025 ) , DeepEvolve ( Liu et al., 2025b ) , CORAL ( Qu et al., 2026 ) , Arbor ( Jin et al., 2026 ) ) and recommender-specific ones (EvoRec ( Mu et al., 2026 ) , Self-EvolveRec ( Kim et al., 2026 ) ); detailed configurations of the datasets, codebases, and baselines are provided in Appendix A.2 , A.3 , A.4 . The platform exposes three feedback channels: (i) offline metrics (Hit@ K K /NDCG@ K K ), (ii) deterministic mathematical probes, and (iii) LLM-based user diagnosis (Appendix A.5 ). Standard general baselines receive only offline metrics channel (i), whereas recommender-specific frameworks (EvoRec, Self-EvolveRec) and TGR-EvoDAG access all three channels. To strictly decouple the benefit of diagnostic feedback from evolutionary search topology, we further construct two naive integration baselines, namely CORAL + Diag. and Arbor + Diag. , which augment the strongest general search frameworks with identical multi-channel feedback. Model selection uses offline validation metrics alone. paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 1 , we make the following observations. (1) Consistent dominance. TGR-EvoDAG leads on every metric, improving over the strongest non-evolutionary baseline APAO by + 24.7 % +24.7\% / + 28.5 % +28.5\% on Hit@10/@20 and + 37.4 % +37.4\% / + 37.2 % +37.2\% on NDCG@10/@20. (2) Disentangling domain feedback from search topology. A critical question is whether the gains of TGR-EvoDAG stem simply from richer feedback or from its DAG-based evolutionary mechanisms. Comparing Arbor with Arbor + Diag. confirms that domain diagnostics indeed help (Hit@10 increases from 0.0792 0.0792 to 0.0814 0.0814 ). However, naively integrating domain feedback into general tree-based or population-based frameworks remains suboptimal: TGR-EvoDAG still significantly outperforms Arbor + Diag. ( + 6.8 % +6.8\% Hit@10, + 16.9 % +16.9\% NDCG@10) and CORAL + Diag. ( + 8.1 % +8.1\% Hit@10, + 16.0 % +16.0\% NDCG@10). This empirical gap demonstrates that feedback richness alone cannot substitute for structural search capabilities: without DAG-based cross-branch merging and stage-aware cost planning, general search frameworks fail to afford upstream tokenizer retraining or overcome temporary regressions during downstream co-adaptation. Furthermore, TGR-EvoDAG beats the strongest domain-specific baseline Self-EvolveRec by + 21.0 % +21.0\% Hit@10 / + 32.8 % +32.8\% NDCG@10 due to its multi-branch exploration. (3) Offline and simulated experience move together. Beyond offline metrics, the Agent4Rec leaps (View + 31.3 % +31.3\% , Satisfaction + 19.7 % +19.7\% , Depth + 25.4 % +25.4\% over APAO) confirm that the discovered architectures yield genuinely better recommendations, answering RQ1 .

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 illustrates the 39-round evolution trajectory from the initial TIGER seed (Hit@10 0.0626 0.0626 ) to the final architecture ( 0.0869 0.0869 ) across five distinct phases, directly answering RQ1–RQ3. (Phase 1) The framework first establishes a robust baseline by injecting both collaborative and semantic IDs into the TIGER encoder, adjusting InfoNCE weights, and grid-searching feature fusion and user pooling methods ( → 0.0673 0.0626\!\to\!0.0673 ). (Phase 2) Next, TGR-EvoDAG opens multiple orthogonal branches based on diagnostic signals. This DAG structure safely explores and deepens parallel mutations (e.g., recency bias, user-conditional decoding) without destabilizing the main trunk, demonstrating a clear advantage over linear frameworks (RQ1). (Phase 3) It then pairwise merges these independently matured branches and stacks them with APAO, creating a single-step performance leap to 0.0824 0.0824 ( + 12.3 % +12.3\% ) and validating the effectiveness of cross-branch merging (RQ3). (Phase 4) Because modifying the upstream tokenizer requires expensive full-pipeline retraining, TGR-EvoDAG strategically defers this to avoid budget waste. It tests the new Repr-LLM encoder on an isolated branch, where introducing PSRQ initially causes a collapse to 0.0599 0.0599 . Diagnostics quickly repair it via RMS normalization and parameter sweeps before trunk integration, demonstrating how stage-aware cost planning overcomes cost blindness (RQ2). (Phase 5) Finally, when this repaired tokenizer is merged into the main trunk, performance initially regresses to 0.0775 0.0775 . Instead of discarding it via greedy search, TGR-EvoDAG retains the node and actively co-adapts downstream components by re-tuning the fine-margin loss. This successfully recovers performance, pushing the model to its final peak of 0.0869 0.0869 after a final merge with the APAO branch, thereby overcoming short-sighted evaluation (RQ3).

paragraphs.en: We re-evolve under restricted variants: A (greedy: no multi-branch, prunes any regression), B (multi-elite but no cross-branch merge), and C (full search but without cost planning, uniform budget across stages). As shown in Figure 4 (a,b), performance rises monotonically from A to Full TGR-EvoDAG on both testset and Agent4Rec metrics. A stalls at a local optimum, as its short-sighted greedy pruning cannot survive the temporary regressions required for downstream co-adaptation. B tolerates these delayed payoffs but remains blind to the compounding gains of merging independent branches, answering RQ3. paragraphs.en: To answer whether diagnostic signals are causally useful in driving mutations, we highlight three critical turning points where offline metrics alone offered no actionable direction. (i) User Diagnosis: When performance plateaued, simulated user feedback explicitly reported that recommendations were “outdated,” motivating the agent to inject an exponential recency bias. When an initial weak prior ( γ = 0.9 \gamma{=}0.9 ) showed no offline improvement, diagnostics confirmed it was absorbed by learnable weights, prompting the agent to apply a stronger signal ( γ = 0.5 \gamma{=}0.5 ) that successfully broke the plateau. (ii) Mathematical Probes: Standard metrics only indicate overall correctness, but mathematical probes isolated a specific “same coarse, wrong fine” error mode. This directly drove the agent to design a targeted within-coarse hard-negative contrastive loss that random mutation could not easily discover. (iii) Distribution Probes: When the new PSRQ tokenizer caused a catastrophic performance drop, an offline-only search would have discarded it. However, distribution probes pinpointed a semantic ID collision spike (to 65.7 % 65.7\% ) due to a k-means scale imbalance. This causal insight guided the agent to apply an RMS normalization repair, dropping collisions back to 1.0 % 1.0\% and unlocking the tokenizer’s potential. Ultimately, while offline metrics only flag failures, these diagnostics provide the exact causal mechanisms required for the agent to execute targeted repairs.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduce TGR-EvoDAG, a multi-agent code evolution framework tailored for Generative Recommendation (GR). We observe that naively integrating existing evolution frameworks fails on GR’s cascaded pipelines due to two fundamental bottlenecks: cost blindness and short-sighted evaluation. To bridge this gap, TGR-EvoDAG harmonizes an advanced Code Directed Acyclic Graph (Code DAG) search mechanism with rich diagnostic feedback. Building upon this foundation, it introduces stage-aware cost planning to explicitly triage edits based on actual GPU overhead, and active downstream co-adaptation to safely navigate temporary regressions and unlock deferred gains. Extensive evaluations on a standardized GR platform demonstrate that TGR-EvoDAG achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming the leading non-evolutionary baseline (APAO) by up to 37.4% in offline metrics and 19.7% in simulated user satisfaction. In addition, successful migration to Tencent’s real-world industrial scenarios yields a 12.16% relative improvement in offline Hit@1 and a statistically significant 0.40% gain in online Click-Through Rate. Moving forward, building on its integration into Tencent’s Uppimo platform, we plan to directly evolve GR pipelines within complex industrial scenarios and to open the platform for public trial. Moreover, since Large Language Model (LLM) training inherently involves cascaded stages, we envision our framework can be naturally extended to optimize multi-stage LLM pipelines.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 TGR-EvoDAG，一个专为生成式推荐（GR）打造的多智能体代码演化框架。 我们观察到，将现有演化框架简单移植到 GR 的级联流水线中会因两个根本性瓶颈而失败：成本盲视与短视评估。 为弥合这一差距，TGR-EvoDAG 将先进的代码有向无环图（Code DAG）搜索机制与丰富的诊断反馈相结合。 在此基础上，该框架引入了阶段感知的成本规划，根据实际 GPU 开销对编辑进行显式分流，并引入主动的下游协同适配，以安全渡过暂时的性能回退并释放延迟收益。 在标准化 GR 平台上的大量评估表明，TGR-EvoDAG 达到了最先进的性能，在离线指标上领先最优非演化基线（APAO）多达 37.4%，在模拟用户满意度上领先 19.7%。 此外，成功迁移到腾讯的真实工业场景后，离线 Hit@1 取得 12.16% 的相对提升，线上点击率取得具有统计显著性的 0.40% 增长。 展望未来，在集成到腾讯 Uppimo 平台的基础上，我们计划在复杂工业场景中直接演化 GR 流水线，并向公众开放平台试用。 此外，由于大语言模型（LLM）的训练本身就涉及级联阶段，我们预见该框架可以自然地扩展用于优化多阶段 LLM 流水线。

paragraphs.en: A node that passes review and yields a valid checkpoint, whether or not it improves on its parent, keeps its default status and remains selectable, since an immediate regression on an upstream edit is precisely the signal that downstream co-adaptation is required. paragraphs.en: In this section, we introduce the open-source Amazon Office dataset used for evolution, as well as the industrial dataset used to verify whether the evolved GR architecture is effective in real-world industrial scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们介绍用于演化的开源 Amazon Office 数据集，以及用于验证演化后的 GR 架构在真实工业场景中是否有效的工业数据集。

paragraphs.en: Amazon Office Dataset . Following the evaluation protocol of the initial codebase ( Yu et al., 2026 ) and prior generative recommendation studies ( Rajput et al., 2023 ) , we conduct all evolution experiments on the Office Products category of the public Amazon Product Review corpus 1 1 1 https://jmcauley.ucsd.edu/data/amazon/links.html . We directly adopt the preprocessed data released by Yu et al. (2026) . For completeness, we restate the protocol under which the released data were produced: each review is treated as one implicit positive interaction, and every user’s interactions are sorted chronologically into a single behaviour sequence. Five-core filtering then iteratively discards users and items with fewer than five interactions. Each history is truncated to the most recent 20 items. Finally, the data is split with the standard leave-one-out strategy. For every user, the chronologically last interaction forms the test instance, the second-to-last forms the validation instance, and the rest are used for training. All evolutionary frameworks therefore optimise and are selected on exactly the same validation split, and the test split is touched only once, for the final checkpoint selected within the budget B B . Item side information (title, brand, category, price and description) is concatenated into a textual description and used exclusively by the item tokenizer. The statistics of the released data are summarised in Table 2 . Let 𝒰 \mathcal{U} , ℐ \mathcal{I} and 𝒟 \mathcal{D} denote the user set, the item set and the interaction set, respectively. We report the average sequence length L ¯ = | 𝒟 | / | 𝒰 | \overline{L}=|\mathcal{D}|/|\mathcal{U}| and the interaction density ρ = | 𝒟 | / ( | 𝒰 | × | ℐ | ) \rho=|\mathcal{D}|\big/\left(|\mathcal{U}|\times|\mathcal{I}|\right) .

paragraphs.en: Real-world Industrial Dataset . The industrial data are collected from Tencent’s large-scale commercial media platform with over 10 million daily active users. paragraphs.en: In this section, we introduce the codebase provided for the evolutionary framework.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们介绍为进化框架提供的代码库。

paragraphs.en: All frameworks evolve upon an identical seed codebase, which is built directly on the officially released APAO implementation ( Yu et al., 2026 ) together with its preprocessed data and its original tokenizer configuration. The codebase is organised into four decoupled modules: (i) item tokenization, (ii) backbone definition, (iii) the pre-training objective, and (iv) a pluggable post-training objective. All four share one data loader and one beam-search evaluator. What is held invariant across all frameworks is the environment : the preprocessed interaction data, the train/validation/test split, the evaluation protocol and the budget B B . Everything above the data layer, including the tokenization module, is exposed as mutable code and may be modified by a candidate during evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 所有框架都在同一个种子代码库上演化而来，该代码库直接基于官方发布的 APAO 实现（Yu et al., 2026），以及其预处理数据和原始分词器配置。 该代码库由四个解耦的模块组成：（i）条目分词，（ii）骨干网络定义，（iii）预训练目标，以及（iv）可插拔的后训练目标。 这四个模块共享同一个数据加载器和一个束搜索评估器。 在所有框架中保持不变的是环境：预处理后的交互数据、训练/验证/测试划分、评估协议以及预算 B B。 数据层之上的所有内容，包括分词模块，都以可变代码的形式暴露，并可在演化过程中由候选方案进行修改。

paragraphs.en: Item Tokenization . Every item is represented by a sequence of discrete semantic tokens rather than a single atomic ID. The seed codebase ships with the tokenizer configuration of Yu et al. (2026) : a semantic embedding is first extracted for each item by feeding its concatenated textual metadata into Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and taking the final-layer representation; a 4-level RQ- K K -means quantizer then residually quantizes each embedding into T = 4 T=4 codes ( y 1 , y 2 , y 3 , y 4 ) (y^{1},y^{2},y^{3},y^{4}) , one per level. Each level owns an independent codebook, and a de-duplication suffix is appended whenever two items collide on all four levels, guaranteeing an injective item ↔ \leftrightarrow code mapping. A user history x = { i 1 , … , i n − 1 } x=\{i_{1},\dots,i_{n-1}\} is thus flattened into a token sequence of length 4 ​ ( n − 1 ) 4(n-1) , and predicting the next item amounts to autoregressively generating its 4 4 semantic tokens. Note that the tokenization module is not frozen: a candidate is free to re-fit or redesign the quantizer (e.g. changing the number of levels, the codebook size or the quantization algorithm) as part of its proposed modification, in which case the downstream backbone is retrained accordingly. Only the upstream interaction data and the splits are fixed. The seed baselines reported in the main text all use the original configuration above.
paragraphs.zh: 物品分词（Item Tokenization）。 每个物品由一串离散的语义 token 表示，而不是单个原子 ID。 种子代码库附带了 Yu 等人 (2026) 的分词器配置。 （2026）：首先将每个物品的拼接文本元数据输入 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 并取最后一层表示，为每个物品提取语义嵌入；然后一个 4 层 RQ-K K-means 量化器将每个嵌入残差量化为 T = 4 T=4 个码（y^{1},y^{2},y^{3},y^{4}），每层一个。 每一层拥有独立的码本，并且每当两个物品在全部四层上发生冲突时，会追加一个去重后缀，从而保证物品 ↔ \leftrightarrow 码的映射是单射的。 因此，用户历史 x=\{i_{1},\dots,i_{n-1}\} 被展平为长度 4 ​ (n-1) 4(n-1) 的 token 序列，而预测下一个物品就等价于自回归地生成它的 4 4 个语义 token。 请注意，分词模块并非冻结的：候选方案可以自由地重新拟合或重新设计量化器（例如更改层数、码本大小或量化算法），作为其提出的修改的一部分，在这种情况下，下游骨干网络会相应地重新训练。 只有上游的交互数据和数据划分是固定的。 正文中报告的种子基线均使用上述原始配置。

paragraphs.en: Backbone . The seed backbone is TIGER ( Rajput et al., 2023 ) , a T5-style Transformer encoder-decoder operating entirely in the semantic-token space. The encoder consumes the flattened history tokens and the decoder autoregressively emits the 4 4 codes of the target item; at inference time decoding is performed with constrained beam search over the valid code trie. Both the encoder and the decoder consist of 4 4 layers with 6 6 self-attention heads of head dimension 64 64 , ReLU activations in all feed-forward blocks, and a learnable token embedding dimension of 128 128 , yielding roughly 0.01 0.01 B parameters in total. The full architectural and optimisation configuration is listed in Table 3 ; all values are inherited from Yu et al. (2026) without modification.

paragraphs.en: SPRec ( Gao et al., 2025 ) is a self-play framework designed to suppress the over-recommendation / filter-bubble bias that plain DPO induces. Each self-play iteration performs one SFT step on the offline interactions followed by one DPO step in which the model’s own predictions from the previous iteration serve as negatives. Because the negative distribution is the current policy’s own output, the DPO loss is implicitly re-weighted by the model logits, adaptively penalising items the model already over-exposes. No extra data or manual intervention is needed.
paragraphs.zh: SPRec（Gao et al., 2025）是一个自博弈框架，旨在抑制普通 DPO 引发的过度推荐 / 信息茧房偏差。 每次自博弈迭代先在离线交互上执行一步 SFT，随后执行一步 DPO，其中模型在上一轮迭代中的自身预测被用作负样本。 由于负样本分布就是当前策略自身的输出，DPO 损失会被模型 logits 隐式地重新加权，自适应地惩罚模型已经过度曝光的物品。 无需额外数据或人工干预。

paragraphs.en: We compare TGR-EvoDAG against six evolutionary frameworks, grouped into general evolutionary frameworks (domain-agnostic) and recommender-specific frameworks (built for recommendation). paragraphs.en: AlphaEvolve ( Novikov et al., 2025 ) orchestrates an autonomous LLM-driven evolutionary pipeline that iteratively evolves and optimizes entire algorithmic codebases by directly editing and testing code against evaluator feedback. It generalizes the FunSearch/Eureka line of LLM-driven code evolution from single functions to whole codebases, but is guided primarily by scalar metrics and carries no recommendation-specific inductive bias.
paragraphs.zh: AlphaEvolve（Novikov 等，2025）编排了一个由大语言模型驱动的自主进化流水线，通过直接编辑代码并依据评估器反馈进行测试，迭代地进化并优化完整的算法代码库。 它将 FunSearch/Eureka 一脉的大语言模型驱动代码进化从单一函数推广到整个代码库，但主要由标量指标引导，不携带任何针对推荐系统的归纳偏置。

paragraphs.en: DeepEvolve ( Liu et al., 2025b ) extends the evolutionary loop with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG): it retrieves external scientific knowledge (e.g., academic papers from arXiv) to systematically inform hypothesis generation and codebase refinement, grounding the evolution in prior work rather than relying on the model’s internal knowledge alone.
paragraphs.zh: DeepEvolve ( Liu et al., 2025b ) 通过检索增强生成（RAG）扩展了进化循环：它检索外部科学知识（例如来自 arXiv 的学术论文），以系统性地指导假设生成与代码库改进，使进化立足于已有研究，而非仅依赖模型的内部知识。

paragraphs.en: CORAL ( Qu et al., 2026 ) is a multi-agent framework for open-ended discovery that replaces rigid control flow with long-running agents that explore, reflect, and collaborate through a shared persistent memory and asynchronous execution.
paragraphs.zh: CORAL（Qu 等，2026）是一个用于开放式发现的多智能体框架，它用长时间运行的智能体取代了僵化的控制流，这些智能体通过共享的持久记忆和异步执行来进行探索、反思与协作。

paragraphs.en: Arbor ( Jin et al., 2026 ) is a general autonomous-research framework built on Hypothesis Tree Refinement : a persistent tree links hypotheses, artifacts, evidence, and distilled insights across time. A long-lived coordinator manages the global strategy over the tree, while short-lived executors implement and test individual hypotheses in isolated worktrees; returned results are propagated back into the tree as reusable lessons that refine the search frontier.
paragraphs.zh: Arbor（Jin et al., 2026）是一个建立在假设树精炼之上的通用自主研究框架：一棵持久化的树随时间推移将假设、产物、证据和提炼出的洞见关联起来。 一个长期存在的协调者在树上管理全局策略，而短期存在的执行器在隔离的工作树中实现并测试单个假设；返回的结果会作为可复用的经验传播回树中，从而精炼搜索前沿。

paragraphs.en: EvoRec ( Mu et al., 2026 ) is a multi-agent framework that co-evolves both the recommendation model and the optimization methodology driving it. Four agents (an Orchestrator, a Research Agent, a Code Agent, and a Skill Evolver) run a dual-track loop: the Research and Code agents iterate the model each round, while the Skill Evolver periodically distills reusable methodology from a persistent memory of past experiments into a self-evolving skill library. It is domain-aware but is guided primarily by offline metrics, without the directional diagnosis.

paragraphs.en: During evolution the environment produces, for every executed candidate, a structured feedback bundle assembled from three complementary diagnostic channels, following the directional-feedback design of Self-EvolveRec ( Kim et al., 2026 ) (which pairs a qualitative User Simulator with a quantitative Model Diagnosis Tool ) and specialising it to the 4-layer semantic-ID (SID) generative recommender. The three channels are: (i) offline validation metrics, giving a macro-level view of ranking quality; (ii) deterministic mathematical probes, exposing internal failure modes that aggregate metrics cannot express; and (iii) qualitative user diagnosis, surfacing behaviour-level deficiencies in natural language. While offline metrics in Channel (i) are available to every framework, diagnostic feedback in Channels (ii) and (iii) is provided exclusively to domain-specific methods, naive integration variants (Arbor + Diag. and CORAL + Diag.), and TGR-EvoDAG. For these methods, the diagnostic content is emitted stage-aware : the bundle carries separate fields for the supervised-fine-tuning stage ( sft_* ) and the post-training stage ( post_* ), so that multi-stage diagnostics are produced only if a candidate actually modifies post-training; a single-stage candidate (e.g., pure TIGER) receives only the sft_* fields.
paragraphs.zh: 在进化过程中，环境会为每个被执行的候选方案生成一个结构化的反馈包，该反馈包由三个互补的诊断通道组装而成，遵循 Self-EvoRec（Kim et al., 2026）的方向性反馈设计（该设计将定性的用户模拟器与定量的模型诊断工具相结合），并将其专门化到 4 层语义 ID（SID）生成式推荐器上。 这三个通道分别是：(i) 离线验证指标，提供排序质量的宏观视角；(ii) 确定性数学探针，揭示聚合指标无法表达的内部失效模式；(iii) 定性用户诊断，以自然语言的形式呈现行为层面的缺陷。 虽然通道 (i) 中的离线指标对每个框架都可用，但通道 (ii) 和 (iii) 中的诊断反馈仅提供给领域特定方法、朴素集成变体（Arbor + Diag. 和 CORAL + Diag.）以及 TGR-EvoDAG。 对于这些方法，诊断内容是分阶段输出的：反馈包为监督微调阶段（sft_*）和后训练阶段（post_*）分别设置了独立的字段，因此只有当候选方案确实修改了后训练时才会生成多阶段诊断；单阶段候选方案（例如纯 TIGER）仅接收 sft_* 字段。

sents.zh: 这三个通道分别是：(i) 离线验证指标，提供排序质量的宏观视角；(ii) 确定性数学探针，揭示聚合指标无法表达的内部失效模式；(iii) 定性用户诊断，以自然语言的形式呈现行为层面的缺陷。

sents.en: While offline metrics in Channel (i) are available to every framework, diagnostic feedback in Channels (ii) and (iii) is provided exclusively to domain-specific methods, naive integration variants (Arbor + Diag. and CORAL + Diag.), and TGR-EvoDAG.
sents.zh: 虽然通道 (i) 中的离线指标对每个框架都可用，但通道 (ii) 和 (iii) 中的诊断反馈仅提供给领域特定方法、朴素集成变体（Arbor + Diag. 和 CORAL + Diag.）以及 TGR-EvoDAG。

sents.en: For these methods, the diagnostic content is emitted stage-aware : the bundle carries separate fields for the supervised-fine-tuning stage ( sft_* ) and the post-training stage ( post_* ), so that multi-stage diagnostics are produced only if a candidate actually modifies post-training; a single-stage candidate (e.g., pure TIGER) receives only the sft_* fields.
sents.zh: 对于这些方法，诊断内容是分阶段输出的：反馈包为监督微调阶段（sft_*）和后训练阶段（post_*）分别设置了独立的字段，因此只有当候选方案确实修改了后训练时才会生成多阶段诊断；单阶段候选方案（例如纯 TIGER）仅接收 sft_* 字段。

paragraphs.en: Agent4Rec metrics are used strictly for evaluation. They are computed only once, on the single checkpoint finally retained under the budget B B , and serve exclusively to compare the frameworks in the main results table. They are never computed for intermediate candidates, never exposed to any evolving framework, and never used for model selection. Model selection relies solely on the offline validation metrics defined above. Consequently, no framework can optimise these numbers directly, and they function as a genuinely held-out behavioural measurement.

paragraphs.en: We stress that this evaluation simulator is fully disjoint from the user simulator that supplies the third feedback channel during evolution. The latter follows the qualitative-diagnosis design of Self-EvolveRec ( Kim et al., 2026 ) and emits natural-language diagnostic reports (Appendix A.5 ) rather than scalar scores. The two components are isolated along two axes: (i) the user populations are drawn from disjoint user sets, so no agent that participates in evolution-time diagnosis is ever reused for final measurement; and (ii) their outputs are of different kinds and consumed by different parties: diagnostic text is consumed by the coding agent during the search, whereas the three metrics above are consumed only by us, after the search terminates. This separation rules out any feedback path from the evaluation protocol back into the evolutionary process. Within the evaluation simulator itself, the agent population, the random seeds and the interaction templates are fixed once and shared by all frameworks, so the reported comparison is deterministic and paired.
paragraphs.zh: 我们强调，该评估模拟器与在演化过程中提供第三条反馈通道的用户模拟器是完全分离的。 后者遵循 Self-EvolveRec（Kim 等，2026）的定性诊断设计，输出自然语言诊断报告（附录 A.5），而非标量分数。 这两个组件在两个维度上相互隔离：（i）用户群体取自互不相交的用户集合，因此参与演化阶段诊断的任何智能体都不会被复用于最终测量；（ii）它们的输出类型不同且由不同方使用：诊断文本由编码智能体在搜索过程中使用，而上述三个指标只在搜索结束后由我们使用。 这种隔离排除了从评估协议反馈回演化过程的任何路径。 在评估模拟器内部，智能体群体、随机种子和交互模板均一次性固定并被所有框架共享，因此所报告的比较是确定性的且成对的。
